**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement sits at the **preferred** position for MINCOMMIT — we take on no minimum purchase commitment, committed volume, or shortfall exposure:

- **Section 4 (Fees)** obliges us only to pay license fees, annual maintenance/support fees, and taxes as priced in Exhibit B — no guaranteed minimum or true-up/penalty mechanic.
- **Exhibit B revenue sharing** (p0157–p0160) is purely usage-based: Application Management Revenue accrues only on actual Corio Customer invoices and only once a Customer begins live operations. Implementation fees are time-and-materials with a cap in our favour.
- **No volume caps on us**: Software Users are "Unlimited" (p0151) and Section 2.1(iv) allows sublicensing an unlimited number of Customers.
- The one "minimum" hit (p0158, 40 Authorized Software Users per Customer) sits inside a carve-out that *relieves* us of revenue share on the initial 3000 licences — it benefits our side, so not flagged.
- **Exhibit D** is expressly "non-binding," and the two-initial-customers item is commercially reasonable efforts only.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged as a deviation: the five-year initial term with annual MarketSite.net access and maintenance fees and no convenience termination right. This is a subscription fee structure rather than take-or-pay, and maintenance is expressly conditioned on our electing to continue paying (Sections 4.2, 11.3), so it does not fail the fallback.
